payload.summary: research sources: web research deliberately skipped per the founding instruction (domain knowledge sufficed) — drafted from domain knowledge alone. Consulted from knowledge: (1) standard Clue/Cluedo ruleset — 6 suspects, 6 weapons, 9 rooms, one solution triple sealed in the case file, remaining cards dealt round-robin, turn = move-then-suggest, a suggestion pulls the named suspect and weapon into the suggester's room and is refuted by the first clockwise player holding any one of the three named cards shown privately to the suggester alone, an accusation is checked against the case file and a wrong accusation bars the accuser from further accusations while they keep refuting; (2) LLM-as-game-master patterns — the model narrates and answers in-fiction while a deterministic engine owns legality, so no rule outcome depends on parsing model prose; (3) OpenAI-compatible chat completions APIs — POST /v1/chat/completions with a bearer key, body of model plus a messages array, response at choices[0].message.content, and a usage object carrying prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/total_tokens, which is the hook for the token-cost sharing the paragraph asks about. Poe's https://api.poe.com/v1/chat/completions implements this shape.
